definitions.explanation: A name given to someone based on their characteristics, appearance, or other features, often used among friends or classmates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧なあだ{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけられた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was given a strange nickname.

notes:
あだ{名|な} refers to a nickname — an informal name given based on someone's characteristics, appearance, habits, or a play on their real name. Common among children and close friends.

WRITING:
Usually written as あだ{名|な}. The full kanji forms {渾名|あだな} and {綽名|あだな} are rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あだ{名|な}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to give a nickname
- あだ{名|な}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call by a nickname
- あだ{名|な}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to get a nickname
- ⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧なあだ{名|な}: a weird nickname

CULTURAL NOTE:
Nicknames are very common among Japanese schoolchildren. They are often formed by shortening a name (e.g., たかはし → たかし), adding ちゃん or ⟦くん→くれる：00724_kureru⟧, or based on physical traits or personality.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ニックネーム→ニックネーム：23549_nikkuneemu⟧: nickname (loanword, more neutral)
- ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧: pet name, term of endearment (more formal)
